info.title: Totem OS API
info.description: Versioned REST contract shared by the Next.js API, React and Swift clients.

get.description: Stateless contract endpoint used to verify pagination and client decoding.

post.description: Stateless contract endpoint used to verify JSON, validation and CSRF handling.

403.description: Capability or CSRF token is missing.

get.description: Returns the authenticated session, capabilities, preferences, branding and counters owned by the Swift shell.
Returns the native or legacy-web mode for each route after applying the authenticated user's rollback overrides.
Returns retained changes after an opaque sequence cursor.

410.description: Cursor is older than retained history.

post.description: Applies up to 50 mutations and returns one result for each mutation.

403.description: Dashboard capability is missing or CSRF token is missing.

409.description: A mutation conflicts with the server version.

get.description: Returns the latest materialized entities and a cursor for subsequent pulls.

authjsSession.name: authjs.session-token
authjsSession.description: Auth.js session cookie. The secure production cookie uses the __Secure- prefix.

csrfToken.name: x-csrf-token
csrfToken.description: Required for mutating requests together with the CSRF cookie.
